items.name: orb-demo
items.title: Orb Demo
items.description: A worked example of Orb: A sphere that carries what an assistant is doing, settled when idle and moving with the voice when there is one.

items.name: otp-input-demo
items.title: OTP Input Demo
items.description: A worked example of OTP Input: A one time code, one box per character, where pasting the whole code into any box fills the rest.

items.name: page-navigator-demo
items.title: Page Navigator Demo
items.description: A worked example of Page Navigator: A rail of page thumbnails for moving through a long document, with arrow-key navigation and a clear active page.

items.name: pagination-demo
items.title: Pagination Demo
items.description: A worked example of Pagination: Page numbers with gaps where the run is broken, as buttons or as your own links.

items.name: pdf-viewer-demo
items.title: PDF Viewer Demo
items.description: A worked example of PDF Viewer: Page-by-page PDF rendering on a canvas, with paging and zoom, over any loader you give it.

items.name: presence-field-demo
items.title: Presence Field Demo
items.description: A worked example of Presence Field: An ambient backdrop that carries what the assistant is doing. It changes colour and pace with the state, and settles into each one rather than snapping to it.

items.name: prompt-input-demo
items.title: Prompt Input Demo
items.description: A worked example of Prompt Input: The composer. Grows with the message, sends on Enter, keeps Shift+Enter for a new line, and turns into a stop button while a reply streams.

items.name: questionnaire-demo
items.title: Questionnaire Demo
items.description: A worked example of Questionnaire: The questions an agent asks before it starts. One at a time, with single or multiple answers, an open answer alongside them, and required ones it will not move past.

items.name: redaction-demo
items.title: Redaction Demo
items.description: A worked example of Redaction: Mark regions to black out before a document leaves the building, with a reveal that says plainly it is only a preview.

items.name: render-surface-demo
items.title: Render Surface Demo
items.description: A worked example of Render Surface: The canvas the other scenes are drawn on. It stays the size of its box, sleeps when nobody is looking at it, and holds still when motion is reduced.

items.name: resizable-panels-demo
items.title: Resizable Panels Demo
items.description: A worked example of Resizable Panels: Two panels and something to drag between them, where the divider is a real separator that also works from the keyboard.

items.name: response-actions-demo
items.title: Response Actions Demo
items.description: A worked example of Response Actions: The row under an answer: copy it, ask again, and rate it. Drops into the actions slot on Message.

items.name: response-demo
items.title: Response Demo
items.description: A worked example of Response: An assistant's answer as markdown, including while it is still half-written and briefly invalid.

items.name: reveal-demo
items.title: Reveal Demo
items.description: A worked example of Reveal: Moves its children in when they arrive on screen. It changes how something arrives and never whether it is there.

items.name: reviewable-diff-demo
items.title: Reviewable Diff Demo
items.description: A worked example of Reviewable Diff: A proposed change reviewed a hunk at a time: take three of the seven, leave the rest, apply what you took.

items.name: scene-hero-demo
items.title: Scene Hero Demo
items.description: A worked example of Scene Hero: A lit three-dimensional object behind a headline, steered by the pointer and coloured by the theme. The one component here that asks for three.

items.name: schema-builder-demo
items.title: Schema Builder Demo
items.description: A worked example of Schema Builder: Build the shape you want extracted from a document. Fields carry a name, type, description, and requirement, and object and array fields nest.

items.name: scroll-scene-demo
items.title: Scroll Scene Demo
items.description: A worked example of Scroll Scene: Turns the scrolling of a tall element into a number between nought and one, published to a custom property and to a callback, without rendering the page to do it.

items.name: scroll-to-top-button-demo
items.title: Scroll to Top Button Demo
items.description: A worked example of Scroll to Top Button: A floating way back after someone has moved down a long page or scroll area. It stays hidden near the top.

items.name: scrub-bar-demo
items.title: Scrub Bar Demo
items.description: A worked example of Scrub Bar: The seek control on its own: a slider that happens to be a timeline, announced in minutes and seconds.

items.name: secret-field-demo
items.title: Secret Field Demo
items.description: A worked example of Secret Field: An API key or token: hidden until asked for, copied whole either way.

items.name: shader-surface-demo
items.title: Shader Surface Demo
items.description: A worked example of Shader Surface: Four shader backdrops -- caustics, metal, plasma and ripple -- each taking its two colours from your theme, so the same surface arrives dark in a dark application and light in a light one.

items.name: shift-button-demo
items.title: Shift Button Demo
items.description: A worked example of Shift Button: A call to action that trades its leading icon for a directional cue when someone approaches it.

items.name: shimmering-text-demo
items.title: Shimmering Text Demo
items.description: A worked example of Shimmering Text: Words with a light moving across them, for the wait between asking and the first token.

items.name: side-panel-demo
items.title: Side Panel Demo
items.description: A worked example of Side Panel: A pane that comes in from the side: an inspector, a filter set, a row's detail.

items.name: signature-footer-demo
items.title: Signature Footer Demo
items.description: A worked example of Signature Footer: A complete closing section with room for the useful links first and one oversized wordmark at the end.

items.name: signature-pad-demo
items.title: Signature Pad Demo
items.description: A worked example of Signature Pad: Sign with a pointer on a canvas, or type a name instead. Returns a PNG data URL or the typed text.

items.name: skeleton-demo
items.title: Skeleton Demo
items.description: A worked example of Skeleton: A placeholder the shape of what is coming, so the page does not jump when it arrives.

items.name: sortable-list-demo
items.title: Sortable List Demo
items.description: A worked example of Sortable List: A list reordered by dragging a handle, or from the keyboard without one, where every move is announced.

items.name: source-card-demo
items.title: Source Card Demo
items.description: A worked example of Source Card: One retrieved passage: where it came from, what it said, and how well it matched.

items.name: spinner-demo
items.title: Spinner Demo
items.description: A worked example of Spinner: The smallest way to say something is happening, for a control that is working.

items.name: split-text-demo
items.title: Split Text Demo
items.description: A worked example of Split Text: A heading animated one character, word, or line at a time, and still announced as one sentence rather than as a pile of single letters.

items.name: spotlight-card-demo
items.title: Spotlight Card Demo
items.description: A worked example of Spotlight Card: A card that catches a light following the pointer, and can light every card in its grid from the same pointer at once.

items.name: status-pill-demo
items.title: Status Pill Demo
items.description: A worked example of Status Pill: A dot and a few words: operational, degraded, closed.

items.name: stepper-demo
items.title: Stepper Demo
items.description: A worked example of Stepper: Where someone is in something with a beginning and an end, said in words as well as drawn.

items.name: stop-generating-demo
items.title: Stop Generating Demo
items.description: A worked example of Stop Generating: The control that interrupts a running answer, with the time it has been going and Escape wired up.

items.name: stopped-run-demo
items.title: Stopped Run Demo
items.description: A worked example of Stopped Run: What the thread says after an answer ended early, with whatever it had already written kept above the line.

items.name: stream-glow-demo
items.title: Stream Glow Demo
items.description: A worked example of Stream Glow: An edge that breathes along a region while tokens land in it, and stops the moment they do.

items.name: streaming-text-demo
items.title: Streaming Text Demo
items.description: A worked example of Streaming Text: Text that arrives a piece at a time from an async source, with a cursor while it runs and sentence-level announcements for screen readers.

items.name: subagent-tree-demo
items.title: Subagent Tree Demo
items.description: A worked example of Subagent Tree: Several agents working at once, nested under whoever handed the work down, each with its own state and elapsed time.

items.name: suggestions-demo
items.title: Suggestions Demo
items.description: A worked example of Suggestions: A row of prompts to start or continue with, for the moment someone does not know what to ask.

items.name: table-of-contents-demo
items.title: Table of Contents Demo
items.description: A worked example of Table of Contents: An outline of the page that keeps up with the reader, marking the section they are in as they scroll.

items.name: tag-input-demo
items.title: Tag Input Demo
items.description: A worked example of Tag Input: An input that turns what you typed into a removable tag, and gives the last one back when you press backspace on an empty field.

items.name: terminal-output-demo
items.title: Terminal Output Demo
items.description: A worked example of Terminal Output: Streaming command output with stderr called out, an exit code, and scroll that follows without trapping you.

items.name: theme-toggle-demo
items.title: Theme Toggle Demo
items.description: A worked example of Theme Toggle: A light and dark switch that survives a reload, follows the system when asked, and stays in step across tabs.

items.name: thinking-state-demo
items.title: Thinking State Demo
items.description: A worked example of Thinking State: A status row for work in progress, with a live elapsed timer and optional reasoning behind a disclosure.

items.name: tilt-card-demo
items.title: Tilt Card Demo
items.description: A worked example of Tilt Card: A card that leans toward the pointer as though it were a physical object lying on the page.

items.name: timeline-demo
items.title: Timeline Demo
items.description: A worked example of Timeline: Things that happened, in the order they happened, with the state of each one said aloud rather than left in a coloured dot.

items.name: token-meter-demo
items.title: Token Meter Demo
items.description: A worked example of Token Meter: How much of the context window is gone, split by what spent it, and a warning before it runs out.

items.name: tool-call-demo
items.title: Tool Call Demo
items.description: A worked example of Tool Call: A compact record of one tool invocation: name, status, duration, and the input and output behind a disclosure.

items.name: transcript-viewer-demo
items.title: Transcript Viewer Demo
items.description: A worked example of Transcript Viewer: A recording as text, where every line is also the way back to the moment it was said.

items.name: video-player-demo
items.title: Video Player Demo
items.description: A worked example of Video Player: Video with captions that can be turned on, a real scrubber, and controls that survive full screen.

items.name: voice-input-demo
items.title: Voice Input Demo
items.description: A worked example of Voice Input: A microphone that draws what it is hearing, so a live one is told apart from a dead one at a glance.

items.name: web-preview-demo
items.title: Web Preview Demo
items.description: A worked example of Web Preview: A sandboxed frame for whatever the assistant just built, with the widths to check it at.

items.name: wireframe-globe-demo
items.title: Wireframe Globe Demo
items.description: A worked example of Wireframe Globe: A wireframe world with places marked on it, arcs between them, and the same places written out underneath as text.
